text:
Nils Hoglander left the only NHL team he had known, Vancouver, and is producing for Nashville on fourth-line minutes. He has 9 points (4 goals) in 19 games on under 11 minutes a night, and 6 points in his last ten, including two assists at Los Angeles and a goal and an assist at Anaheim this week (one of them feeding Filip Forsberg on the rush, per NHL.com).

Some of that is the bounces. With him on the ice the Predators have scored 7.08 more goals than their chances deserved, and our numbers had him at about 2.9 points over that ten-game stretch against the 6 he got. But the chances are real too: 1.07 expected goals per 60 on his own shots, more than double what he managed in Vancouver last season, and Nashville has 51.9% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there, 6.1 points better than without him. His ice time has climbed to 13 and 14 minutes the last three games. If that holds, the points have more room to settle without disappearing.
headline: Nils Hoglander has found a role in Nashville
